cohort.label: Official dated Nifty 500 index-fund holdings proxy
cohort.policy: Freeze all 500 October 2024 fund holdings before test start. Retain later index exits, missing/delisted names and failures in dispositions; never select from current membership.
cohort.limitation: Fund portfolio proxy may differ from the exact index at the margin; not an independently certified historical constituent master. Frozen membership after start is a cohort experiment, not a reconstituted index strategy.
